entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker of the Gatewatch who has come to Amonkhet to hunt one of the demons that hold contracts on her soul.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepath and planeswalker of the Gatewatch who follows Liliana into the embalming chambers and fights the mummies with illusions and mind control.

entities.name: The Raven Man
entities.description: A ghostly figure in archaic black clothing with flat golden eyes who has haunted Liliana since she was young and presses her to kill her demons and use her friends.

entities.name: Temmet
entities.description: An arrogant teenage vizier of Amonkhet who gave Liliana and Jace housing and catches them in the embalming chambers.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A demon who holds one of the contracts on Liliana's soul, shown guarding the gate to the afterlife in a mural on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon who rules Amonkhet in absentia as God-Pharaoh and brokered Liliana's demonic contracts.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch who seems to actually like Amonkhet.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch whom Liliana says might not have come had she known about the demons.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon who held a contract on Liliana's soul and was killed by the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon who held a contract on Liliana's soul; he was bound in a silver prison and shredded by Liliana.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet whose viziers keep birth records at the Monument of Knowledge.

entities.name: The Chain Veil
entities.description: An evil relic of tremendous power that Liliana carries; it protects her and prevents Razaketh from activating her contract.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A desert plane ruled in absentia by Nicol Bolas, where society is obsessed with gods, trials and the afterlife and mummies serve the living.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The band of planeswalkers that Liliana belongs to and that is assaulting an elder dragon.

entities.name: Embalming Chamber
entities.description: An underground complex in the city where mummies industrially embalm dead initiates and attach cartouches to them.

entities.name: Monument of Knowledge
entities.description: A monument of Kefnet's viziers where birth records are kept.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane where Liliana kept a private residence after joining the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: A plane Liliana visited with the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane where the Raven Man says he protected Liliana's mind.

events.summary: Liliana lounges in a shaded tent, served by mummies, thinking of her hunt for Razaketh and of Nicol Bolas, who brokered her demonic contracts.
events.quote: Razaketh would make three.

events.summary: The Raven Man appears and chides Liliana for sending shades to search rather than looking herself, and presses her to stay focused on her demon.
events.quote: One of your demons is in reach, and time is running out.

events.summary: The Raven Man reveals that he took command of the Chain Veil to blast Liliana out of the wurm's belly when she arrived on Amonkhet, which she did not know.
events.quote: Didn't I take command of the Chain Veil to blast you out of that wurm's belly when you arrived here?

events.summary: Liliana warns the Raven Man to vanish as Jace approaches, and he disappears indignantly.
events.quote: "Don't forget why you're here," he said, and vanished indignantly.

events.summary: Jace finds Liliana at her tent and they discuss the strange mummies and ambient necromancy of the city.
events.quote: it's possible they were raised by some kind of ambient necromancy.

events.summary: A shade reports it has found something, and Liliana leads Jace through the city, noticing that all the mummies are maimed.
events.quote: Have you noticed that all the mummies in the city are maimed?

events.summary: The shade stops at a wall of inscriptions bearing Razaketh's name, which makes Liliana sway.
events.quote: The inscription swam in her vision, and whispers pawed at the edges of her awareness.

events.summary: Hiding in an alcove, Liliana and Jace watch mummies carry the freshly slain bodies of initiates down the corridor.
events.quote: The mummies carried the bodies of initiates slain in combat, dripping blood, wrapped in rags.

events.summary: They follow the mummies into the central chamber and see embalming on an industrial scale, which Liliana judges purely practical rather than religious.
events.quote: Not a religious rite. Purely practical.

events.summary: A corpse stirs before it is wrapped and the mummies silence it by pressing a metal cartouche to its chest.
events.quote: They pressed the cartouche into place on the body's chest.

events.summary: At a mural of the afterlife, Liliana and Jace see Razaketh depicted guarding the gate as the final test.
events.quote: Beyond the gate, Razaketh. Beyond Razaketh, paradise.

events.summary: Liliana admits she is hunting Razaketh, and Jace angrily accuses her of breaking the Gatewatch's trust by hiding her demons.
events.quote: You broke our trust.

events.summary: The carving of Razaketh opens its eyes and the mummies whisper Liliana's name, then attack her and Jace.
events.quote: The carving of Razaketh . . . opened its eyes.

events.summary: Liliana realizes that an ambient magic raises all the dead on Amonkhet and that the mummies are controlled physically through the cartouches.
events.quote: There was something on this world—natural or artificial, it hardly mattered—that raised the dead.

events.summary: Liliana and Jace wrench a cartouche from a mummy, which bursts with white light and falls apart, and the mummies then surround them.
events.quote: The hole left by the cartouche burned with blinding white light, and the mummy fell apart.

events.summary: Temmet arrives, commanding the mummies, and reveals he checked the birth records and knows the pair are outsiders.
events.quote: But I checked the birth records at the Monument of Knowledge,

events.summary: Liliana says they have met the Horned One, and Temmet has the mummies choke her in rage.
events.quote: We've met him, actually,

events.summary: Jace takes control of Temmet's mind, and through him the mummies, then urges Liliana to run.
events.quote: Jace was controlling Temmet, and Temmet was controlling the mummies

events.summary: Liliana and Jace flee the embalming chamber; Liliana says Razaketh knows she is here and only the Chain Veil stops him activating her contract, and Jace admits Temmet will remember what he saw.
events.quote: Chain Veil's the only reason he can't . . . activate my contract.

events.summary: Liliana decides she needs the others and runs from her demon toward help.
events.quote: She ran, away from her demon, toward help.
